عججتن (form I)
# عَجَجْتُنَّ (ʕajajtunna) /ʕa.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
# عُجِجْتُنَّ (ʕujijtunna) /ʕu.d͡ʒid͡ʒ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
